headline: Maddison and Kulusevski back for Spurs, but Chelsea stay clear favourites
summary: Tottenham won their first league game of the season on Monday, 3-1 against Coventry, and James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski are back from injury, according to Yahoo Sports. Even so, Spurs created few clear chances in that win: 0.9 expected goals. Sports Mole lists Pedro Porro among their injury doubts. Chelsea beat Everton 2-0, and their chance on the market average has risen from 52.5% to 54.9%. Tottenham are on 22.5%, less than half, and the handicap gives them a head start of 0.75 goals.
read: Chelsea are clear favourites at 54.9% for the London derby, with the price on the home side shortening in recent days after a 2-0 win at Everton. Tottenham arrive off their first league win of the season and with Maddison and Kulusevski back, but the market still makes Chelsea roughly three-quarters of a goal the better team and expects an open game at three goals.

facts.fact: Chelsea are clear favourites for the derby at 54.9% fair probability, more than double Tottenham's 22.5%.
facts.meaning: The market makes Chelsea the likely winner, but a Spurs result is far from written off.

facts.fact: Chelsea won 2-0 away at Everton in their most recent Premier League match.
facts.meaning: They arrive on a win and a clean sheet, with a full week between games.

facts.fact: Tottenham beat Coventry City 3-1 for their first Premier League win of the season, with James Maddison, Omar Marmoush and Ben Davies scoring.
facts.meaning: Spurs go into the derby off a win rather than a slump, however late it arrived.

facts.fact: James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski both returned from injury and featured in Tottenham's 3-1 win over Coventry.
facts.meaning: Tottenham's creative pair are available for the derby rather than watching it.

facts.fact: Tottenham's injury and suspension list ahead of the Chelsea match is reported to include Pedro Porro, Savio and Lucas Bergvall.
facts.meaning: Spurs are still without three squad players for a trip to Stamford Bridge.

facts.fact: Chelsea's win probability has shortened from 52.5% to 54.9% in recent days.
facts.meaning: The home side has got stronger in the market, not weaker, as kick-off approaches.

facts.fact: The goal line sits at 3.0 with Over priced at 51.2%.
facts.meaning: The market sees an open derby — three goals is roughly the coin-flip total.

facts.fact: Tottenham created only 0.9 xG in their win over Coventry last weekend.
facts.meaning: The 3-1 scoreline was worth more than the chances; Spurs were efficient rather than dominant.

sources.fact: Tottenham claimed their first Premier League win of the season by beating Coventry City 3-1, with James Maddison, Omar Marmoush and Ben Davies scoring.
James Maddison and Dejan Kulusevski both returned from injury and featured in Tottenham's 3-1 win over Coventry City.
Tottenham boss Roberto De Zerbi said after the Coventry win that his side must keep their feet on the ground because the performance was good but they can get better.
Roberto De Zerbi confirmed that two Tottenham players will be available for Saturday's derby at Chelsea despite injury scares, though Spurs have an extensive injury list.
Sports Mole reports that Tottenham's injury and suspension list ahead of the Chelsea match includes Pedro Porro, Savio and Lucas Bergvall, with return dates listed.
Dejan Kulusevski said he had warned his closest family that his return to football might not work out before he came back from injury against Coventry.
Chelsea won 2-0 away at Everton in the Premier League in their most recent match.
Xabi Alonso is Chelsea's head coach and made one change to the starting XI for the Premier League fixture away to Everton.
